learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to use smart replacement words so we never have to repeat the same boring nouns over and over again!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A pronoun is a clever word that takes the place of a noun. Instead of saying 'Rahul is happy because Rahul won', we say 'Rahul is happy because HE won'!
These pronouns replace names of people, animals, or things. Words like I, you, he, she, it, we, and they are all personal pronouns used every single day.
These pronouns show that something belongs to someone! Words like mine, yours, his, hers, ours, and theirs are possessive pronouns. 'That cool pen is MINE!'
These are pointing words! We use 'this' and 'these' to point at things nearby, and 'that' and 'those' to point at things far away.

fun_activity.title: 🔁 The Name Eraser
fun_activity.instructions: Write this sentence: 'Riya loves Riya's new dog, and the dog loves Riya back.' Now, cross out the repeated nouns and write the correct pronouns above them!

quick_recap: ⭐ Pronouns are super words used in place of nouns to make sentences sound better.
⭐ Personal pronouns (he, she, they) stand for people or things.
⭐ Possessive pronouns (mine, yours) show who owns an item!
